# Put the element ID before localization attributes when editing this dialog

During D208387, a reviewer asked to keep id as the first attribute on an archive-dialog control, and the accepted checkbox used id before data-l10n-id. This is a local, explicit 2024 review preference rather than a repository-wide syntax rule: the current dialog also has a newer checkbox with class before id. Preserve the accepted ordering when touching the original control, but inspect nearby newer markup before asking for a general style change.

Scope: Archive dialog XHTML style.

Paths:

- `mailnews/base/prefs/content/am-archiveoptions.xhtml`

## Evidence

[Shared lesson record](../records/715078b5034b079372c07f7ca2c44dc423cbc89ddd2733f229cea5947de52480.json).

- https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D208387
- https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=697706

Source record: `7e01391705c4c5ce24fa7183a2d532cf2bcbc2757b4b7d7b27e0063b97c8198d`

~~~
id="archiveKeepFolderStructure"
          data-l10n-id="keep-folder-structure"
~~~
